The <b>Choral Chambers</b> is an [[Areas (Silksong)|area]] in [[the Citadel]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are golden, [[Silk]]-lined halls that comprise the majority of [[the Citadel]]'s structure, inhabited by the [[Haunting|haunted]] members of [[the Choir]]. Entering the Choral Chambers marks the beginning of [[Act 2]].

== Description ==
[[File:Screenshot_SS_Choral_Chambers_11.png|thumb|200px|left|Eastern section of the Choral Chambers]]
The Choral Chambers is the main and largest area of the Citadel. Grand, gold-adorned halls weave through the Citadel's towering structure. The corridors are lined with gilded trims and elegant Silk drapes befitting the religious centre and capital of [[Pharloom]]. Once a holy place of song, the Choral Chambers now lie in disrepair, inhabited by the reanimated Choir who have fallen to the [[Haunting]] by [[Grand Mother Silk]]. The members of the Choir here drop the most [[Rosaries]], showing that those in the Choral Chambers and the Citadel in general are very devoted to the religion of Pharloom.

Golden bells hang from platforms in the vertical rooms, which [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] can [[Needle-bounce]]. Many platforms in the western part of the halls periodically move in and out of the walls, giving Hornet little time to platform.

To the east, a large rotating hallway can be found. When a lever is struck at either entrance, the contraption rotates and opens up an entrance between the areas. This either connects the [[Cogwork Core]] to the [[Whispering Vaults]], or, in the other position, allows access to the upper east part of the chambers.

The upper halls, connecting to the [[High Halls]] and the [[Memorium]], are long, grand hallways leading to the Cogwork Core. These are guarded by powerful [[Grand Reed]]s, who can fly and lash out with deadly Silk attacks. If Hornet enters the Cogwork Core, she is faced with the [[Cogwork Dancers]].

Near the centre of the structure, [[Loyal Mergwin]] can be found, dedicated to serving his master, the [[Great Gourmand]], and providing food for their insatiable appetite. He gives Hornet a [[Pale Oil]] in exchange for completing the <i>[[Great Taste of Pharloom]]</i> wish. Another Pale Oil can be found in a room to the west, only accessible via the Whispering Vaults.

Bell puzzles can be found in several locations around the Citadel, one of them being in the western section of the Choral Chambers. Solving it requires hitting the bells in the order they play. Solving the puzzle gives Hornet a [[Cogheart Piece]], three of which are used to assemble the Cogheart, which is required to repair the [[Second Sentinel]].

The very eastern section of the Choral Chambers leads to a bridge that connects to [[the Slab]].

== History ==
The Choral Chambers was the area where the Choir used to sing, unknowingly keeping Grand Mother Silk sealed in slumber.<ref>[[The Choir#Disciples|Disciple of the Choir]] Needolin dialogue: <i>"Raise your voices, chosen few! The song sustains! Holy call of the Citadel... Fill the chambers, sacred song..."</i></ref><ref>Pontiff [[Needolin Locations#Whispering Vaults|Needolin dialogue]]: <i>"Damned bugs... We prayed a cage... We sang your chains... Divine Silk..."</i></ref> It was a wealthy area and contained many of the Citadel's facilities,<ref>Choral Chambers [[Needolin Locations#Choral Chambers|Needolin dialogue]]: <i>"...All our wealth... ...All our glory... ...All to end... like this? ...Beauty... faded..."</i></ref> such as a restaurant, a spa, and the main entrance to the theatre in the Whispering Vaults. Pilgrims from all over would make their way to the Citadel in the hope of receiving a great reward.<ref>[[Mort]]: <i>"The lands in every direction punish us, but such is our test. Above it all, the Citadel shines, our destination and our reward... I'll make it there, you'll see. I've easily earned my place in such a paradise."</i></ref><ref>[[Exhausted Pilgrim]]: <i>"My sore shell will cease tormenting me once I reach the Citadel. It's sung that all ails are healed just as soon as we step beyond the Grand Gate..."</i></ref> Those who were admitted entry to the Choral Chambers were initiated into [[the Choir]] to serve the Citadel.<ref>[[Choir Pouncer]] [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Agile bug, and one of few hardy pilgrims to have reached the Citadel."</i></ref><ref>[[Choir Cloak]] description: <i>"Garment gifted to pilgrims on admittance to the Citadel."</i></ref><ref>[[Choir Hornhead]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Full-grown former pilgrim serving the Citadel."</i></ref> The Choirbugs had to fill the Choral Chambers with song, never allowed to waver or wither.<ref>Disciple of the Choir Needolin dialogue: <i>"Our voices will be heard! For our song, the precious Silk! Waver not! Wither not! All must gather! All must sing!"</i></ref><ref>[[Whiteward]] [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Whiteward|Lore Tablet]]: <i>"While song must be sung, none may falter."</i></ref> The ones who were too old or sickly to sing were sent to the [[Whiteward]], where [[Silk]] was inserted inside their bodies to extend their lives.<ref>Hornet and the [[Caretaker]] dialogue: <br><i>Hornet: "In the ward down below, I saw it clear, the hollowed husks, and the many torturous implements... machines to instill a bug with thread, that would see their life extended."<br>Caretaker: "Aye! That's it, in part! But there's more scale to it than all that. Just think of'em greedily shoving the Silk into their shells, the madness that overcame them, eternal life for mortal bugs! Then think on how long it's all gone on..."</i></ref> This eventually made the bugs of the Citadel become [[Haunting|haunted]] by Grand Mother Silk, who possessed them through the Silk within them.<ref>Hornet and the Caretaker dialogue: <br><i>Caretaker: "Have you done it yet, bellringer? Wriggled deep? Discovered the depths of obsession that brought this place so low?"<br>Hornet: "If you speak of this Citadel and its Silk, Caretaker, then yes, I now know the start of it."</i></ref> The Haunting turned the Choral Chambers and the rest of the Citadel into a gilded tomb,<ref>[[Choir Pouncer]] Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Once one of Pharloom's favoured bugs, and yet their domain and their shells would have been the first to fall to the Haunting."</i></ref><ref>Hornet dialogue with the [[Seamstress]]: <i>"I have ventured high, seen the Citadel and its state. That place is long lost... generations lost, a gilded tomb, drowned in Silk dregs."</i></ref> and the Choir's voices fell silent.<ref>Hornet dialogue with the [[Second Sentinel]]: <i>"I had assumed as much. Yet look around you, gilded one. During your slumber, the Citadel has fallen, and its voices lay silent. This place is dead, or very nearly."</i></ref>

== How to Access ==
There are three ways into the Choral Chambers. After defeating the [[Last Judge]] and entering the [[Grand Gate]], a breakable wall in the upper portion of the area leads to a small alcove that connects to the Choral Chambers. If [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] instead takes the lift down to the [[Underworks]], the northeastern section of the area holds an openable connection that leads to the chambers.

The alternate path is via [[Phantom]]. After defeating them in [[Exhaust Organ]], a lift leads to Grand Bellway and to the rest of the Choral Chambers.

<b>Grand Bellway</b> consists of a [[Bellway]] station, a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]], and a [[Ventrica Station]]. It is located in the southeast corner of the Choral Chambers. If Hornet accesses the Citadel through [[Sinner's Road]], she passes through Exhaust Organ, which leads into an alcove that drops her here.

<b>Songclave</b> is located at the northeast corner of the Choral Chambers, and becomes active after Hornet rings the bell bench in First Shrine. Managed by the [[Caretaker]], it serves as a respite for any pilgrims passing through. As more pilgrims populate the area, [[Jubilana]] sets up shop as its merchant, [[Sherma]] stops by to aid the injured, and [[Garmond & Zaza]] also can be found resting here. It also has a [[Wishwall]] where Hornet can take on wishes from its residents. 

The "First Shrine" [[Ventrica Station]] can be found one floor above Songclave.

During [[Act 3]], the entrance to First Shrine is destroyed. The Caretaker leaves to join his family in the [[Ruined Chapel]], giving the role of Caretaker to Sherma, who manages the care of any refugee bugs that have fled to the Songclave or have been rescued by the [[Second Sentinel]].

<b>Citadel Spa</b> is located one floor above the Choral Chambers Ventrica Station, though Hornet must first unlock its doors by moving through the showers' plumbing. She can relax there to enjoy its healing and Silk-restoring properties, and Sherma can also be found here taking a break from his pilgrimage.

* If the <i>[[OPEN: Grand Gate]]</i> objective is active, ringing First Shrine shows a notification indicating the objective has been updated, despite First Shrine not being required for the objective, nor has an update been made.
